name: Stat card
summary: A compact tile that pairs one key metric with its label, an optional trend delta and a short context line. Use for dashboards and summary rows.

anatomy.purpose: Names the metric in plain words (e.g. "Weekly active users").
The single headline number, formatted with units or separators.
Direction and size of change vs. the comparison period, with an arrow or +/- sign, never color alone.
One short line of qualifier text such as the comparison window.

variants.name: Basic
variants.use: Label and value only, for dense KPI rows.

variants.name: With trend
variants.use: Value plus trend delta and comparison window.

whenToUse: A dashboard needs to surface a handful of headline metrics at a glance.
The value needs one line of context, not a full chart.
whenNotToUse: The person needs to explore the data: use a table or chart instead.
There is more than one number competing for attention in the same tile: split into separate cards.

accessibility.role: group (or figure with figcaption when the trend needs a long explanation)
keyboard: Not interactive by default; if the card links somewhere, the whole card is one Tab stop.
accessibility.focus: If clickable, the card shows a visible focus ring (2px solid, 2px offset) with at least 3:1 contrast against the surrounding surface.
notes: Trend direction must be conveyed with text or an icon in addition to color.
Value text must meet 4.5:1 against the card surface; label text at least 4.5:1 as well.
Use a real number format (e.g. 1,240) and set aria-label on the trend if it uses an icon only.

code.html: Weekly active users 12,480 +8.2% vs last week
